title: detached HEAD 与 reflog 救援
expected_output:
detached HEAD 与 reflog 救援
  checkout 提交后 .git/HEAD 内容: b850b4fe9a65a5cd556b972a2d91c60bb67a5f37
  HEAD 不再以 ref: 开头(直接存 SHA): True
  detached 下新提交 SHA: 95bd292
  git reflog -n 3:
    95bd292 HEAD@{0}: commit: detached-work
    b850b4f HEAD@{1}: checkout: moving from main to b850b4fe9a65a5cd556b972a2d91c60bb67a5f37
    b850b4f HEAD@{2}: commit (initial): c1
  救援: git checkout -b rescue 把该提交收编为分支 rescue
结论: detached HEAD 提交仍安全存在于对象库，reflog 记录每次 HEAD 移动，用分支收编即可找回
code:
import os, subprocess, tempfile, hashlib, pathlib

GIT_ENV = dict(os.environ)
for _k, _v in [("GIT_AUTHOR_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_AUTHOR_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_NAME", "dev"), ("GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL", "dev@example.com"),
               ("GIT_COMMITTER_DATE", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")]:
    GIT_ENV[_k] = _v

def g(args, cwd):
    r = subprocess.run(["git"] + args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, env=GIT_ENV)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("git %s failed:\n%s" % (args, r.stderr))
    return r.stdout

def new_repo():
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="repo_")
    g(["init", "-q", "-b", "main"], d)
    g(["config", "user.name", "dev"], d)
    g(["config", "user.email", "dev@example.com"], d)
    g(["config", "commit.gpgsign", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.autocrlf", "false"], d)
    g(["config", "core.eol", "lf"], d)
    return d

def w(d, name, content):
    p = pathlib.Path(d) / name
    if isinstance(content, str):
        p.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))
    else:
        p.write_bytes(content)

def blob_sha(content_bytes):
    b = content_bytes.encode("utf-8") if isinstance(content_bytes, str) else content_bytes
    h = hashlib.sha1()
    h.update(b"blob " + str(len(b)).encode() + b"\x00" + b)
    return h.hexdigest()


d = new_repo()
w(d, "a.txt", "x\n")
g(["add", "-A"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "c1"], d)
c1 = g(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], d).strip()
g(["checkout", "-q", c1], d)
head_content = pathlib.Path(d, ".git", "HEAD").read_text().strip()
w(d, "b.txt", "y\n")
g(["add", "-A"], d)
g(["commit", "-q", "-m", "detached-work"], d)
det = g(["rev-parse", "HEAD"], d).strip()
reflog = g(["reflog", "-n", "3"], d).strip()
print("detached HEAD 与 reflog 救援")
print("  checkout 提交后 .git/HEAD 内容: " + head_content)
print("  HEAD 不再以 ref: 开头(直接存 SHA): " + str(not head_content.startswith("ref:")))
print("  detached 下新提交 SHA: " + det[:7])
print("  git reflog -n 3:")
for l in reflog.splitlines():
    print("    " + l)
print("  救援: git checkout -b rescue 把该提交收编为分支 rescue")
print("结论: detached HEAD 提交仍安全存在于对象库，reflog 记录每次 HEAD 移动，用分支收编即可找回")
